question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo></math>Methylhex-2-ene on reaction with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>HBr</mi></math> in presence of peroxide forms an addition product (A). The number of possible stereoisomers for ' <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> ' is ________.

solution.text:
The hydrogen bromide addition in peroxides follows Anti Markovnikov rule.  Anti Markovnikov  addition reaction is found to follow a free radical mechanism. The peroxide compound involved helps in the generation of free radicals. The Anti-Markovnikov rule defines regiochemistry in which the substituent is attached to a less substituted carbon instead of the more substituted carbon.
